title: Prime a commercial roll-towel dispenser after a refill
instruction: Start the new roll in the open paper-towel dispenser. Feed a straight, unbroken tail through the outlet and leave the lever released.
context: Janitors and cleaners routinely supply restrooms (O*NET 37-2011.00; BLS May 2025 counted 2.21 million US jobs in this occupation). Priming a hardwound towel after a refill leaves paper reachable from the outlet for the next user. This scene starts with the fresh roll seated and the loose leader outside the rollers.
setup: Standard bimanual YAM station, table top z=747.5 mm. Coordinates x away from the arms, y left, z up. Wall-mounted ABS roll-towel dispenser 318 mm wide by 324 mm high, open for service, with rear plate x=544 mm and lower outlet lip at z=820 mm; its fixed mounting plate extends down to the counter. A 203 mm wide, 150 mm diameter paper roll is held at x=461, z=1065 mm, parallel to y. The loose leader stays outside the rollers. Its horizontal free edge starts at x=311 and z=981.5 mm and overhangs the loading cradle by 15 mm. Two 28 × 30 × 4 mm ABS cradle rails are centered at x=340 mm, y=−67 and −18 mm, with top surfaces at z=980.6 mm. A front 8 × 30 × 158 mm post at x=294 mm supports both rails through a 54 × 30 × 6 mm cantilever and a 12 × 79 × 6 mm crosspiece. Roller axes sit at x=408 and 448 mm, z=934 mm. The 6 × 250 mm front and 9 × 283 mm rear steel axles carry 39.6 mm diameter rubber bands on the y intervals −109.5 to −46 mm, −32 to 22 mm and 119 to 127 mm. The front idler is on a spring-returned ABS arm with Y-axis pivot (408,0,850) mm. Its blue 12 × 30 × 16 mm tab is centered at (319,−231,950) mm at rest. Moving its tab down and forward to the 58° stop opens the pressure roller gap to 72 mm. The low-rate torsion spring is preloaded at the closed stop. Its 10 mm steel shaft passes through a 22 × 20 mm opening in the right ABS panel; the loading tab clears the lever laterally. A 75 mm sprung feed lever is on the left at pivot (365,167,953) mm, returning to its upper stop. Two passive pairs of 4 mm ABS guide fins at y=−39.7 and +99 mm narrow toward a 3.3 mm opening above the nip. The frame and hardware details are in the README and scene source.
scoring: Zero unless the connected leader passes through the closed roller nip squarely (loading arm within 3 degrees of rest). This seated state earns 0.25. Score 0.5 for 15 mm below the outlet and at least 10 mm advanced by a lever stroke. Score 1.0 for at least 50 mm below the outlet and 35 mm advanced by lever strokes, with both hands clear and the lever within 3 degrees of rest for 10 steps. Observe the closed nip, both roller index marks and the lever in the RGB video. Measure the vertical towel exposed below the outlet lip with a ruler on the physical fixture. A torn leader or damaged setup earns zero.
reset_notes: Place the square leader across the cradle rails with 15 mm protruding. Reset the roll, roller bearings, loading arm, lever, arms, RGB buffers and score counters.
fidelity: Wall-mounted manual dispenser with a native hinged idler carrier, segmented rollers and an opposite-side feed lever. The robot must open the nip, grasp the connected leader, insert it, and let the idler close. A torque-limited ratchet drives only the rear roller. Rubber contact entrains the colliding articulated paper. Hinge bending, effective thickness, rubber grip and bearing loads approximate the real materials. Paper tearing and twist are omitted.
scores: Dream-1 beta: 0.0 (400 controls, bounded trial). Scripted demo: 1.0 (905 controls, including the 10-control dwell). Seed 0, object jitter 0, 20 Hz.
